<cite ref="Sanhedrin 63b">Snh. 63ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Megillah 25b:17">Meg. 25ᵇ</cite> (sarcasm on <he>כבודו</he>, <cite ref="Hosea 10:5">Hos. X, 5</cite>) <he>א״ת כְּבוֹדוֹ אלא כְּבֵידוֹ</he> (Ms. M. <he>כּוֹבְדוֹ</he>) read not ‘his dignity’ but ‘his weight’ for it is gone, i.e. the idol’s weight is reduced; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 326">Yalk.
